title: The Dragon in Stormwind
summary: Onyxia's hidden influence in Stormwind leads from political paralysis to Marshal Windsor's investigation and a dragon's exposure.
opening: A kingdom recovering from earlier wars carried an enemy into its own court. The story asks how secrecy and distrust weakened Stormwind before anyone reached Onyxia's lair.
reviewNote: Blizzard's overview supports Onyxia's manipulation; verify Windsor and the Great Masquerade in original quest text.
